name: Online-Golu
description: A place to build an online Golu set where anyone can visit, create their own mini figurine, and place it on the stairs and share it online.

paragraphs: A community Bommai Golu on the web. Anyone can make a little customizable Golu doll (a Bommai) in under a minute and place it on one of the shared 9-step Golus, which stand back to back on a turning stage.
Core loop: see the Golu → Add your Bommai → customize → pick it up and drop it on a free spot on the steps → share. You can drag your own Bommai to another spot on its Golu later.

Getting around the Golu (works as soon as the page opens): drag to look around, two-finger scroll to move, pinch (or a mouse wheel) to zoom, and the + / − / Reset view buttons in the corner. Movement is limited to a box around the Golu so it can't drift out of view (BOUNDS and the angle/distance limits in CameraRig, src/three/GoluScene.jsx).

whatItDoes.text: A community Bommai Golu on the web. Anyone can make a little customizable Golu doll (a Bommai) in under a minute and place it on one of the shared 9-step Golus, which stand back to back on a turning stage.

requirements.text: Visitors get a silent anonymous session (signInAnonymously); there is no login screen.
Turn on Authentication → Sign In / Providers → Allow anonymous sign-ins in the Supabase dashboard.
